games.title: Dredge
games.note: Its two-paragraph pitch aimed to combine at least two gameplay loops, inspired by Papers, Please and Moonlighter.

games.title: Dave the Diver
games.note: Inspired by a real restaurant on Jeju Island whose owner dives for ingredients by day and serves them at night.

games.title: Animal Well
games.note: Billy Basso's solo project; it was the first game published by Bigmode, the label of YouTuber videogamedunkey.

games.title: Pizza Tower
games.note: Its creator McPig felt the dormant Wario Land series needed a spiritual successor.

games.title: Undertale
games.note: Toby Fox made it almost single-handedly after a 2013 Kickstarter; every monster can be spared instead of killed.

games.title: Deltarune
games.note: Its first chapter came out free on Halloween 2018; the name is an anagram of Undertale.

games.title: EarthBound
games.note: Known as Mother 2 in Japan; written and directed by copywriter Shigesato Itoi.

games.title: Moon: Remix RPG Adventure
games.note: An anti-RPG where you grow by collecting love from helping creatures rather than by killing monsters.

games.title: Touhou: The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
games.note: The first Touhou game for Windows; ZUN makes the series largely by himself.

games.title: Cave Story
games.note: Daisuke Amaya made it alone over about five years and released it as freeware in 2004.

games.title: Hotline Miami
games.dev: Dennaton Games (Jonatan Söderström and Dennis Wedin)
games.note: Grew from Jonatan Söderström's abandoned top-down shooter Super Carnage, which Dennis Wedin found and saw potential in.

games.title: Teardown
games.note: Dennis Gustafsson founded Tuxedo Labs in Malmö in 2019; early access began in October 2020.

games.title: SteamWorld Dig
games.note: Released first on the Nintendo 3DS in August 2013.

games.title: Katamari Damacy
games.note: Keita Takahashi drew on Tamakorogashi, a school sports-day game in which students push a giant ball.

games.title: Donut County
games.note: Grew from a game-jam prototype about moving a hole, based on a pitch by the parody account Peter Molydeux.

games.title: Untitled Goose Game
games.note: Began with a stock photo of a goose posted in the Melbourne studio's chat.

games.title: Pentiment
games.note: Josh Sawyer first pitched a historical game like it in the 1990s.

games.title: Stardew Valley
games.note: Eric Barone made it alone over about four years; it had sold over 50 million copies by February 2026.

games.title: Terraria
games.note: Released in May 2011, earlier than planned after a beta leaked; it has sold over 70 million copies.

games.title: Astro Bot
games.note: Won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2024.

games.title: Astro's Playroom
games.note: Came pre-installed on the PlayStation 5 to show off the DualSense controller.

games.title: Black Myth: Wukong
games.note: Game Science announced 10 million copies sold within three days of its August 2024 launch.

games.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
games.note: Won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2025, taking a record nine awards.
